schema: CREATE TABLE jobs ( job_id VARCHAR(10) PRIMARY KEY, job_title VARCHAR(35) ); CREATE TABLE employees ( employee_id DECIMAL(6,0) PRIMARY KEY, job_id VARCHAR(10), salary DECIMAL(8,2), FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES jobs(job_id) );
correct_query: SELECT T2.job_title, LHS.avg_sal FROM (SELECT job_id, AVG(salary) AS avg_sal FROM employees GROUP BY job_id) AS LHS JOIN jobs AS T2 ON LHS.job_id = T2.job_id ORDER BY T2.job_title

expected_mutants_to_kill.query: SELECT T2.job_title, AVG(T1.salary) FROM employees AS T1 JOIN jobs AS T2 ON T1.job_id = T2.job_id GROUP BY T2.job_title ORDER BY T2.job_title
